root_cause_label: Output Format Mismatch - Unverified Format Assumption
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent implemented stack-trace analysis with a plausible but incorrect output format (e.g., indentation and header lines), never checked the expected format specification, and prematurely claimed success without detecting the mismatch.
t_err_evidence: output_lines.append(f"  Frame {j}: {format_frame(frame)}") uses two leading spaces instead of required three
t_commit_evidence: In step 4, the script is executed and /app/output.txt is written with the incorrect format; after this point the agent only reads output and claims success, never attempting to fix the format.
trigger_explanation: The agent assumed its self-generated output format (line headers, spacing, indentation) was correct without verifying against any task-provided expected output or test specification. This false premise about format requirements was embedded in the script at step 3 and never challenged.
